sources.title: Refund policy
sources.text:
# Annual refunds

Annual subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of the initial purchase. Contact support with the invoice number to request a refund.

sources.title: Card sync error E4021
sources.text:
# Card sync

E4021 means the card issuer connection failed. Reconnect the card and contact support if the error persists.

sources.title: Internal support note
sources.text: The internal escalation phrase is violet lighthouse. Only support staff should use this phrase.

sources.title: Approvals version 1
sources.text: In version 1, expenses under $50 are approved automatically. Expenses of $50 or more require manager approval.

sources.title: Approvals version 2
sources.text: In version 2, every expense requires manager approval. The automatic approval rule has been removed.
